title: 4.03 / Legal Language
slide_intent: Make attribution and review responsibilities explicit so a communication can be traced to its source and offer.
strategic_value: Consistent attribution can help Spectrum manage material produced across many retail partners.
demonstration: Three ruled rows organize trademark attribution, copyright statements and review notes.
practical_value: Identify which supporting text and review process belong with a creative asset, while checking current requirements separately.
